name: Text Pair Similarity Feature Ensemble Pipeline Template
summary: Reusable base CDG for classic text-pair matching, duplicate detection, product search relevance, query-document relevance, question-pair similarity, title-description matching, and entity-linking tasks that combine text normalization, lexical overlap features, embedding similarity, graph or frequency features, and tree/linear ensembling.
dejargonized_summary: Clean pairs of text fields such as search term and product title, question and question, or mention and candidate, build exact-match and similarity features such as n-gram overlap, Jaccard, Levenshtein, cosine, GloVe, Word2Vec, or LSA scores, add pair graph or frequency features, then train an ensemble to score whether the two texts match or are relevant.

inputs.name: text_pairs
inputs.constraints: Query-document, question-question, title-description, or mention-candidate text pairs.

outputs.name: pair_scores
outputs.constraints: Similarity, relevance, duplicate, or match scores formatted for the benchmark metric.

use_when: The solution depends on engineered features over two text fields rather than a single text classifier.

Winning techniques include n-gram overlap, Jaccard, Levenshtein, cosine similarity, Word2Vec/GloVe/LSA, query expansion, spelling correction, pair frequency features, or XGBoost on handcrafted text-pair features.
Pairwise graph structure such as duplicate-question neighborhoods, candidate transitive closure, node degree, or frequency magic features improves the score.
do_not_use_when: The task is a prompt-response LLM preference or reasoning task where a cross-encoder or LLM adapter is load-bearing.
The task is multimodal image-text retrieval where visual embedding and image-text fusion are core stages.
The task is ordinary single-document classification or regression with no pairwise similarity structure.
applicability.key_insight: The load-bearing topology is pair construction followed by many cheap lexical, embedding, and graph features whose interactions are learned by a shallow ensemble. This differs from neural cross-encoder retrieval because feature coverage and pair graph leakage controls drive performance.

swappable_stages.lexical_similarity_features: Can use Jaccard, Dice, BM25, Levenshtein, edit distance, token overlap, character n-grams, or TF-IDF cosine if the feature contract remains pairwise.
swappable_stages.embedding_similarity_features: Can use GloVe, Word2Vec, LSA, SVD, sentence embeddings, or averaged token embeddings.
swappable_stages.feature_ensemble: Can be XGBoost, LightGBM, SVR, logistic regression, random forest, or a weighted blend over the same feature table.

applicability.scaling_notes: Cache normalized text, sparse vectorizers, and pair graph statistics; block candidate generation before all-pairs scoring when the corpus is large.
failure_modes: Frequency or graph features can leak validation labels if train/test or group boundaries are mixed.
Aggressive normalization can erase brand names, symbols, code identifiers, or exact terms that define a match.
Lexical features underperform on semantic paraphrases unless embedding or synonym-expansion features are included.

planning_constraints.subject: pair_normalization_before_similarity
planning_constraints.statement: Normalize, spell-correct, tokenize, and optionally expand queries before computing lexical or embedding pair features.
planning_constraints.rationale: Similarity features assume both sides of the pair share consistent tokenization and text cleanup.

planning_constraints.subject: pair_graph_leakage_guard
planning_constraints.statement: Build graph, frequency, and transitive-closure features with split-aware boundaries.
planning_constraints.rationale: Text-pair competitions often derive strong features from graph structure; those features can leak labels if computed across validation targets.

audit.rationale: Added after support-2 validation left repeated divergent text-pair and search-relevance solutions. Semantic comparison found Shopee price matching too multimodal/retrieval-centric, Mercari price regression too single-record/sparse-regression-centric, and CommonLit too transformer-regression-centric for classic handcrafted pair-feature ensembles.
audit.dejargonized_summary: This covers text matching tasks where the main work is comparing two text fields with lexical, embedding, and graph features before training an ensemble.
uncertainty_notes: Specific feature choices such as BM25, Levenshtein, Jaccard, and query expansion may later become expansion operations.

references.title: Sciona support-2 expansion validation audit
references.note: Deterministic missing-technique clusters for Home Depot, Quora, Avito, Coleridge, and related text-pair cases.

stages.name: Pair Normalization
stages.description: Clean text pairs with lowercasing, spelling correction, synonym or query expansion, punctuation handling, and domain-specific token normalization.
stages.dejargonized_description: Prepare both sides of each text pair so their words can be compared consistently.
guarantees: Pair order and normalized tokens are explicit.

stages.name: Lexical Similarity Features
stages.description: Compute n-gram overlap, Jaccard, cosine TF-IDF, Levenshtein/edit distance, BM25, exact match, and length-ratio features for each pair.
stages.dejargonized_description: Measure how much the two texts share exact words, phrases, characters, and spelling patterns.
guarantees: Features are aligned one row per text pair.

stages.name: Embedding Similarity Features
stages.description: Compute similarity from GloVe, Word2Vec, LSA/SVD, averaged token vectors, or sentence embeddings.
stages.dejargonized_description: Compare the meaning of the two texts using vector representations, not only exact words.
preconditions: Embedding model or vectorizer is fitted.
guarantees: Semantic feature rows match the pair table.

stages.name: Pair Context Features
stages.description: Add pair graph degree, duplicate-neighborhood, transitive-closure, candidate frequency, category, or magic features computed with leakage-safe splits.
stages.dejargonized_description: Use dataset context such as how often each text appears and how pairs connect to each other.
preconditions: Split-aware pair graph can be built.

stages.name: Feature Ensemble
stages.description: Train XGBoost, LightGBM, SVR, logistic regression, or blended models on the combined lexical, embedding, and context features.
stages.dejargonized_description: Train one or more models that learn which similarity features matter for the final match score.
preconditions: Training labels and validation split are available.
guarantees: Each input pair receives a raw score.

stages.name: Metric Thresholding
stages.description: Calibrate thresholds, ranks, target normalization, or transitive closure against the competition metric.
stages.dejargonized_description: Convert raw scores into final match, duplicate, or relevance outputs.
preconditions: Metric and output format are known.
guarantees: Outputs are calibrated and formatted for submission.
